He holds bread gently at his upper chest height, so offering gesture is unmistakable in UPPER CENTER of painting between their faces. Real natural fingers, small child's hands, no dramatic crying. Kindness despite exhaustion, not triumphant smile.
Three figures grouped close together in center third, medium-small, heads in upper third. Bread at center of frame, higher than their waists. Quiet empty shaded stone and soft foliage on both outer quarters; quiet packed dirt below. Delicate anime faces harmonized with painterly environment, natural human proportions, expressive warm light, beautiful restrained detail. Kai's mark is tiny hair-thin outline above anatomical LEFT eyebrow, never centered forehead or over nose. No weapon drawn, no magic beam.
